description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which spans 12 distinct domains. The largest segment, colored blue, represents the “AI/NLP Research” domain, accounting for 24.3% of the total. The second-largest segment, in teal, corresponds to “Econ. & Fin.” at 18.4%. Other domains are distributed as follows: “Daily Life” (7.1%, light green), “Med & Health” (6.7%, yellow), “Science” (6.7%, light blue), “Law” (5.1%, pink), “Pet & Animal” (5.5%, orange), “Business” (5.9%, red), “History” (8.2%, dark yellow), “Geography” (2.7%, dark green), “Math” (1.2%, very dark green), and “Game&Anime” (8.2%, purple). Each slice is labeled with its domain name and percentage, connected by lines to the corresponding segment, and the chart visually emphasizes the dominance of AI/NLP Research and Econ. & Fin. categories.
